trades.name: LBAF/hold of 7405-7408
trades.quote: In terms of a “setup” a LBAF of 7405-7408 is the best long setup. A hold of 7405-7408 is fine as well but I do tend to expect that a LBAF would produce a stronger response (bulls haven’t really been lacking in strength though, have they?).
trades.stop_hint: A LBAF of 7405-7408 doesn’t need to come all the way to 7396-7399 but there is some demand there from Friday and it includes Wednesday’s high.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: A LBAF of Friday’s low has to be kept back of mind all day, whether from a quick LBAF or a proper test of 83-85, etc.

trades.name: LAAF of Friday's high
trades.quote: As mentioned in the weekly plan, a LAAF of Friday’s high is a valid short and is always a valid potential short. We just need to ask ourselves how interested we are in shorts just yet. For me that means smaller size, tighter stops, and quicker profit takes if I take it at all. Once back below 7422, a move to 7410-7412 seems reasonable with 7405-7408 the major target. Monitor for continuation from there.
trades.stop_hint: smaller size, tighter stops, and quicker profit takes if I take it at all

trades.name: Responsive buying 29256 down to 29218-29238
trades.quote: If trend is going to continue directly then NQ will most likely find buyers by 29256 down to 29218-29238 so, I’ll monitor for responsive buying to join the long side. This is the safest long and targets 286, 317-341, and then monitor for continuation from there.

trades.name: Long in 29166-29186
trades.quote: There was a fair amount of selling in the 166-186 range on Friday which included the IB high and sellers’ (rather pathetic) attempts at triggering a LAAF the IB high. Given broad bullish context I’m willing to look for longs in this situation as well and just know that it needs to reclaim 218-238 and 256 to find a rotation back to 286, 317-341 and monitor for continuation from there.

trades.name: LBAF of 29126 (Friday's VAL)
trades.quote: As NQ approaches 29126 and just below, I start to look for a defense from bulls higher than Friday’s A-period singles below 29073. There is some minor demand just below 126 which was roughly Friday’s VAL. During an active daily trend (OTFU), buying a LBAF of a prior day VAL is generally an absolute gift until the trend phase is negated.

trades.name: LBAF of 29073
trades.quote: We know from the weekly plan that we’re monitoring for a LBAF of 29073 as well.

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low (via 28800-28817)
trades.quote: We also know to monitor for 28800-28817 (inclusive of a LBAF) to trigger a LBAF of Friday’s low from the weekly commentary.

trades.name: Failure to sustain above 29317-29341
trades.quote: A failure to sustain above 29317-29341 invites a trip to 286, 256, and potentially 218-238 and is therefore a valid short but again, shorts for me are rentals at best right now so that means smaller size, tighter stops, and quicker profit takes if I take them at all.
trades.stop_hint: smaller size, tighter stops, and quicker profit takes if I take them at all
